Situate in the land of five rivers, We, Lakshmi Engineering Works, began our journey in 1996 as a product + service based enterprise. The core of our service Is Nickel and Chrome Electroplating and Polishing, making the goods ready to go for their use. The main products which We started from and also currently  doing for job work :-

  • Machinery and Corrugation parts .
  • Automated Stitching And Perforation machines.
  • Hand-tool drilling machines
  • Accessories of various vintage vehicles which Involves silencer, handles , rims , etc.
  • Kirpan / Sword blades – MAJORLY OUR JOB WORK SERVICE.

Our Own Line of Products- In addition to this ,We also deal In  Sikh Items, which are being used for Prakash purposes for Shri.Guru Granth Sahib. These Items Include Prakash Arrowhead(Teer) , Prakash Chakar , Prakash Chawar(chaur) , With more than 20 years of experience in Nickel and Chrome plating , WE decided to launch a product based startup , which embarked its journey from 1st November,2019. Since, having know It all science behind swords/blades, also having a strong network/connections  in our city  and being deeply associated with Sikhism, WE started our In-house manufacturing for Handicrafts  and launched our products in the Indian Market. But as pandemic stroke, our operations was heavily affected by It and WE started to explore various platforms which promoted online selling. One of the platforms, was Etsy and our shop named KraftMartIN, is able to garner the 700 + clients from U.S.A. and Much more from the other parts of the world. WE are also listed on various e platforms like Instagram (Lakshmi engineering works), EBay(Lakshmicraftstore), India art (Lakshmi Engineering Works). After working with more than 3000+ domestic and 1900+ International clients, which solely acts as a motivator behind this venture. A venture which will assist you with your
requirements.

A venture called kraftmart, your all in one store, for

  • Customized Sikh Articles and Accessories
  • Personalized Bidding Handicrafts  
  • Custom Engraving options for your product
  • Punjabi Hand-Cuff Katas
  • Elegant Gold and Silver wire work handicrafts
  • Miniatures Collectibles Pieces
  • Home Décor- wall hanging Products.

As a proud subsidiary of Lakshmi Engineering Works, at kraftmart, We specialize in creating exquisite Indo-traditional handicrafts, Sikh Kaka articles, and Bidding accessories, catering to a diverse clientele who appreciate authentic and culturally rich Items. We take great pride in my exceptional craftsmanship, which Is Evident in every piece we produce, from Intricately designed handicrafts to meaningful Sikh Kakar articles that hold deep spiritual significance. Additionally, We offer bespoke engraving services, allowing customers to personalize their purchases to their exact specifications, adding a unique touch to each Item.

Our commitment to customer satisfaction Is unwavering; We have a dedicated team that promptly
addresses and resolves customer requests, ensuring a seamless and pleasant shopping experience. To further enhance our services, we maintain a FedEx account, facilitating swift and reliable delivery within 10 days, excluding processing time. This efficient delivery system underscores my dedication to providing not only high-quality products but also exceptional customer service, making kraftmart  a preferred choice for those seeking beautifully crafted, personalized Items that reflect a rich
cultural heritage.
